Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Fit Ninja different from other workout apps? +
Fit Ninja combines 1,324+ animated video exercise demos, automated progressive overload algorithms (Greyskull LP, Linear Progression), real-time front & back muscle heatmaps, and a full AI macro nutrition engine into a single 100% offline-capable PWA.
Does the app work without internet in the gym? +
Yes! Fit Ninja is built with an offline-first architecture. All your workouts, exercise logs, sets, and macro calculations are cached locally on your device and sync seamlessly whenever you reconnect.
Can I choose Indian Vegetarian or Vegan diet plans? +
Yes. You can select between High Protein Balanced, Indian Vegetarian (Paneer, Soya, Dal), Ketogenic Low-Carb, and Plant-Based Vegan with customized daily macro targets.
How do I cancel my subscription? +
You can cancel your subscription with 1-click at any time directly inside the app settings with zero cancellation fees or lock-in contracts.
